name: Lift.KummerChart.exists_depth_step
summary: Take g ∈ Γ' with gz = [ε]^{p^a}z and write gE = ωE; then zτ divides ω − 1, so φ^a(ω^n − 1) = zτ·X. The bound θφ^{−a}(X) | p^{cost(a,n)} comes from lifting the exponent (θ(ω^n − 1) | p^{v_p(n)}θ(ω − 1)) and from comparing θ(ω − 1) with θ of a derivative of E at z, which divides p^d, and with θ([ε]^{p^a} − 1)z, which costs 3a.

steps.claim: Choose: γ ∈ Γ' with γ·z = [ε]^{p^a}·z (hg; exists_smul_z); a polynomial F over Λ with F(z) = E·G (hG) and θ(F'(z)) dividing p^d, d = differentExp (T; exists_derivative_dvd_p_pow); t with (θ(τ) + 1)^p = θ(τ)^p + 1 + p·θ(τ)·t (ht; exists_add_pow_prime_eq with x = θ(τ), y = 1: (x + y)^p = x^p + y^p + p·x·y·r); and a unit u with E·τ·u = μ (he; E·τ is associated to μ).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, ⟨F, ⟨G, hG⟩, T⟩, ⟨t, ht⟩, u, he⟩ := exists_smul_z (p ^ a),
    exists_derivative_dvd_p_pow,
    exists_add_pow_prime_eq P.out (theta tau) 1, k.associated_E_mul_tau_mu

steps.claim: γ·E = E·ω for a unit ω (h₀; γE is associated to E), and zτE divides γE − E (D; zTau_mul_E_dvd_smul_sub).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨⟨ω, h₀⟩, D⟩ := k.associated_smul_E (toGp g.1), zTau_mul_E_dvd_smul_sub ⟨_, g, rfl⟩ k.E

steps.claim: As γE − E = E(ω − 1) and E ≠ 0: zτ divides ω − 1.
steps.lean: erw [← h₀, ← mul_sub_one, mul_comm, mul_dvd_mul_iff_left k.E_ne_zero] at D

steps.claim: ω^{|n|} − 1 and ω^n − 1 are associated (for n < 0, ω^n − 1 = −ω^n(ω^{|n|} − 1)).
steps.lean:
have A : Associated (ω.1 ^ n.natAbs - 1) ((ω ^ n).1 - 1) :=
    n.rec (by simp) (⟨-ω⁻¹ ^ ·.succ, by simp [sub_mul, ← mul_pow]⟩)

steps.claim: φ^a(ω^n − 1) = zτ·X for some X (hX): zτ divides φ^a(zτ) (zTau_dvd_phi_pow_smul), which divides φ^a(ω − 1) and so φ^a(ω^n − 1) (steps 3, 4); and the binomial expansion F(γz) = F(z) + F'(z)(γz − z) + r·(γz − z)² (hr).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨X, hX⟩, r, hr⟩ := (k.zTau_dvd_phi_pow_smul a).trans
    (_root_.map_dvd (toRingHom _ _ («φ» ^ a)) ((D.trans (sub_one_dvd_pow_sub_one ..)).trans A.dvd)),
    (F.map (algebraMap ..)).binomExpansion k.z.1 (toGp g • k.z - _)

steps.claim: It suffices that θφ^{−a}(X) divides p^{cost(a,n)} in O_C: then, θ being surjective, θ(υ₀)·θφ^{−a}(X) = p^{cost(a,n)} for some υ₀ ∈ A_inf.
steps.lean: have ⟨υ, _⟩ := theta_surjective.exists.1 (?_ : thetaPhiInv a X ∣ p ^ cost a n)

steps.claim: Take g = (0, γ), the unit φ^a(ω), υ = φ^a(υ₀) and X: g·p_a = φ^a(γE) = φ^a(ω)p_a (γ commutes with φ); p_a divides γz − z = ([ε]^{p^a} − 1)z, as θφ^{−a} kills it, hence divides γs − s for all s ∈ S (dvd_smul_sub_of_fixesLambda, γ fixes Λ); p_a divides υX − p^{cost(a,n)} by step 6 (frobE_dvd_iff); and zτX = φ^a(ω)^n − 1 by step 5.
steps.lean:
use ⟨_, g, rfl⟩, .map (toRingHom _ _ («φ» ^ a)).1 ω, «φ» ^ a • υ, X, by
    erw [frobE_eq, smul_phi_pow_comm, ← h₀]; simp [mul_comm], k.dvd_smul_sub_of_fixesLambda (hg ▸ by
    simp [frobE_dvd_iff, ← iterate_frobEnd_teichmuller, ← phi_pow_smul]) (fixes g).1, by
    simp [frobE_dvd_iff, *, mul_comm], by simp [← hX, smul_sub, ← map_zpow]

steps.claim: Multiply by θφ^{−a}(zτ) ≠ 0 (p_a ∤ zτ): θφ^{−a}(zτX) = θ(ω^n − 1), and by lifting the exponent (θ surjective, z a non-unit dividing ω − 1, and p·θ(ω − 1)·θ(z) | θ(ω − 1)^p, checked with ht and the form of τ) θ(ω^n − 1) divides p^{v_p(n)}·θ(ω − 1); so it suffices that θ(ω − 1) divides p^{d + 3a}·θφ^{−a}(zτ) (the multiplier θφ^{−a}(zτ) stays on the right side; for a = 0 it is θ(zτ)).
steps.lean:
grw [← mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (not_frobE_dvd_zTau a ∘ frobE_dvd_iff.2), ← map_mul, ← hX,
    toRingHom_apply, thetaPhiInv_phi_pow, A.dvd', lifting_the_exponent theta_surjective ω k.z
    k.chart.4 (dvd_of_mul_left_dvd D) (D.rec fun d e ↦ by
    simp [e, zTau, mul_pow]; grw [← sub_eq_of_eq_add (sub_eq_of_eq_add ht),
      ← pow_dvd_pow (theta k.z) P.out.two_le, ← dvd_pow_self (theta d) out]
    use -t; simp [tau, (map_pow _ epsRoot p).symm.trans untilt_epsTilt]; ring) (by omega)]

steps.claim: Rewrite the binomial expansion hr: F(γz) = γ(F(z)) (γ fixes the coefficients), γz = [ε]^{p^a}z (hg), so Δ := γz − z = ([ε]^{p^a} − 1)·z = ([ε] − 1)·G_a·z with G_a = Σ_{j<p^a} [ε]^j, and [ε] − 1 = μ = E·τ·u (he): Δ = E·τ·u·G_a·z; with F(z) = E·G (hG) and γE = ωE (h₀), F(γz) = ωE·γ(G), and the factor E is cancelled (E ≠ 0) before θ is applied: ω·γ(G) = G + F'(z)·τ·u·G_a·z + r·E·(τ·u·G_a·z)².
steps.lean:
erw [add_sub_cancel, eval_map_algebraMap, aeval_algHom_apply (AlgHom.mk (toRingHom ..) (fixes
    g).1), hg, ← sub_one_mul, ← mul_geom_sum, ← mu, ← he, toRingHom_apply] at hr
  simp [hG, ← h₀, k.E_ne_zero, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm _ k.E.1, ← mul_add, sq] at hr

steps.claim: Apply θ: θ(E) = 0 kills the last term, γ fixes θ(G) (γ fixes Λ and θ(z), smul_theta_of_fixesThetaZ), and θ(G_a) = p^a as θ([ε]) = 1; so θ(G)·(θ(ω) − 1) = p^a·θ(F'(z))·θ(τ·u·z). (Applying θ before cancelling E would give 0 = θ(F'(z))·θ(Δ) = 0, since θ(Δ) = 0, and lose the first-order term.)
steps.lean:
apply_fun theta at hr
  simp [k.theta_E, k.smul_theta_of_fixesThetaZ (fixes g), ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add', ← sub_one_mul] at hr

steps.claim: Hence θ(ω) − 1 divides p^a·θ(F'(z))·θ(τ·u·z) (step 10), which divides p^{a+d}·θ(τ·z) (T: θ(F'(z)) divides p^d; u a unit); so it suffices that p^{a+d}·θ(τ)·θ(z) divides p^{d+3a}·θφ^{−a}(zτ) (step 8); split on a:
steps.lean:
grw [map_sub, map_one, Dvd.intro _ hr, T, u.coe_dvd (a := 1), cost, padicValInt]
  cases a; simp [zTau]; ring_nf; rfl
  grw [k.theta_z_dvd_p, tau_dvd_xi_sub_p]
  simp +arith [← pow_succ, ← pow_succ', ← pow_add, pow_dvd_pow, dvd_mul_of_dvd_right]

steps.claim: a = 0: both sides are p^d·θ(zτ) (θφ^0 = θ), so the divisibility is an equality up to order.
a = a' + 1: θ(z) divides p and τ divides ξ − p, so the needed power of p divides; compare exponents.
steps.lean:
grw [k.theta_z_dvd_p, tau_dvd_xi_sub_p]
  simp +arith [← pow_succ, ← pow_succ', ← pow_add, pow_dvd_pow, dvd_mul_of_dvd_right]
